announcements.text: Announced 15 Oct 2026: during 26 Oct–1 Nov 2026, CFD European equities and specified European indices/commodities shift one hour later in MT4/MT5; original hours return 2 Nov. Applies to affected symbols across CFD Challenge and FTMO Account cohorts; cTrader displays the selected timezone. Max Daily Loss still resets at Prague midnight, with a 2-hour MetaTrader offset that week. Check the official symbol list and Account MetriX countdown.

From 12 Oct 2026: Stellar Lite Challenges purchased/reset on or after this date require 2 trading days per evaluation phase; earlier cohorts retain 5. Stellar 2-Step still requires 5 per phase. Lite/1-Step/2-Step FundedNext Accounts have no minimum trading days. The separate 3-Day/On-Demand reward requirements remain unchanged at 5 minimum trading days.

Effective 6 Oct 2026: all models and purchase cohorts, evaluation and funded, prohibit VPN/VPS/proxy/hosted routing during trading; breach and affected payout ineligibility apply. VPN is permitted for initial login only, disconnected before trading. Clarified 12 Oct: GOAT's dashboard Trade Copier is exempt; other VPS/hosted copiers remain prohibited.

Announced 8 Oct 2026: from 12 Oct 2026, 09:00 GMT+3, new 1-Step Challenge orders use Consistency (all-day net profit), replacing Best Day (positive-day profit). 1-Step FTMO Accounts merged from 12 Oct also switch. Earlier orders retain Best Day through passing, rewards and successor accounts.

6 Oct 2026, 00:00 UTC: funded trade minimum hold changes from 120s to 60s for challenges purchased from this date. Earlier purchases, including later resets, retain 120s; evaluation is excluded. Shorter-trade profits are removed at payout, losses still count; this is not an account breach.
26 Jul 2026 historical announcement: FundingPips announced removal of subjective rules. Historical announcement, not a waiver of current prohibited-trading policies.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: subjective rules removal announced
announcements.appliesTo: FundingPips evaluation models; current account agreement still applies.

announcements.text: 26 Jul 2026 historical announcement: Announcement concerns evaluation risk restrictions, not daily drawdown or maximum-loss limits. It is not a removal of all trading rules.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: evaluation risk restrictions removed
announcements.appliesTo: Evaluation stage only; not Zero or Master-account risk controls.

announcements.text: 26 Jul 2026 historical announcement: The announcement explicitly includes Standard 8%/5% accounts. Legacy 10%-target accounts have size-dependent rules; do not treat all Standard accounts alike.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: per-trade hard-breach removal
announcements.appliesTo: 2-Step Standard 8%/5% model only; check purchase cohort and agreement.

announcements.text: 28 Sep 2026 rulebook cutoff: purchases before this date follow legacy rules; new purchases and account resets after this date follow the current rulebook. Applies by account purchase/reset cohort across FundingPips models. Exact cutoff-day treatment is not stated; confirm it with the firm.
Stellar scale-up update: purchases/resets before 12 Jan 2026 retain the previous plan; those after the date follow the new plan.
From Feb 2026: Express 1-Step, Classic 2-Step and Instant start swap-free automatically; older legacy programs are excluded.

Historical purchase-cohort change effective 21 Sep 2026: Instant Premium immediate-funded accounts purchased from this date use a 14-day reward cycle instead of 10 days; earlier purchases retain the 10-day cycle. This is specific to Instant Premium, not other GOAT models or an evaluation phase. The official article does not specify reset treatment.
